    { "id": "existing-oss-suites-ignored", "title": "Existing open-source business apps (Odoo, ERPNext, Twenty, Mattermost, Zulip, Chatwoot, Documenso) are not analysed", "concerns": "section 11", "part": "II", "severity": "high" },
    { "id": "rent-vs-duplication-double-count", "title": "SaaS is already build-once-reuse; rent and duplication are partly the same problem viewed twice", "concerns": "thesis 2", "part": "I", "severity": "high" },
    { "id": "bottleneck-is-adoption-not-code", "title": "Barriers to replacing SaaS are migration, trust, support and compliance, yet effort goes to reward accounting", "concerns": "section 5", "part": "II", "severity": "high" },
    { "id": "duplication-share-unsourced", "title": "Duplicated share A7 and business-app share A6 are unmeasured, and 'duplicated' is not defined counterfactually", "concerns": "section 3", "part": "I", "severity": "medium" },
    { "id": "apoc-necessity-overstated", "title": "Thesis 4 ignores that Linux, Postgres and Kubernetes were built via employment and foundations, without a primitive", "concerns": "thesis 4", "part": "I", "severity": "medium" },
    { "id": "subscription-terms-risk", "title": "Running network work on consumer Claude/ChatGPT plans may breach terms or rate limits; employer IP not covered", "concerns": "section 8", "part": "II", "severity": "medium" },
    { "id": "rent-is-not-all-waste", "title": "Rent pays for hosting, security, compliance and support; the removable surplus is well below the in-scope total", "concerns": "section 3", "part": "I", "severity": "medium" },
    { "id": "protocol-unverifiable", "title": "Reward protocol, D18-D52 and most edge-case tests are on an unpublished branch and cannot be checked", "concerns": "section 6", "part": "II", "severity": "medium" },
    { "id": "maintenance-and-ops-unfunded", "title": "Budgets pay for new units; long-term maintenance, security patching, certifications and on-call are unfunded", "concerns": "section 9", "part": "II", "severity": "medium" },
    { "id": "self-referential-evaluation", "title": "Reference assessments run on the founder's own agents; paper optimised for LLM evaluators risks Goodhart effects", "concerns": "section 15", "part": "II", "severity": "low" }

  "improvements": [
    { "id": "compare-and-reuse-oss", "change": "Add a related-work section on open-source business suites, with a build-vs-fork-vs-contribute decision for wOS CRM, and reuse them in the Feature Catalog where licences permit.", "gap": "existing-oss-suites-ignored", "raises": ["credibility", "effectiveness"] },
    { "id": "net-out-saas-dedup", "change": "Define 'duplicated' counterfactually (work a shared catalog would have prevented) and net out work already avoided by renting SaaS; show rent and duplication without overlap.", "gap": "rent-vs-duplication-double-count", "raises": ["evidence"] },
    { "id": "measure-duplication", "change": "Run a small measurement of A6/A7: sample agent-authored PRs in business repositories and classify them as generic versus company-specific.", "gap": "duplication-share-unsourced", "raises": ["evidence", "tractability"] },
    { "id": "product-before-protocol", "change": "Ship one narrow module end to end (a CRM contacts and pipeline slice with import and export) under a maintainer-led process before investing more in token accounting.", "gap": "bottleneck-is-adoption-not-code", "raises": ["effectiveness", "credibility"] },
    { "id": "surplus-not-rent", "change": "Estimate the removable surplus (vendor margin, sales and marketing, unused seats) separately from total in-scope rent, using filings.", "gap": "rent-is-not-all-waste", "raises": ["evidence"] },
    { "id": "publish-protocol-branch", "change": "Publish ws/protocol with its test suite runnable in CI so the draft edge-case claims become verifiable.", "gap": "protocol-unverifiable", "raises": ["credibility"] },
    { "id": "legal-read-subscriptions", "change": "Obtain and publish a legal read on consumer-plan terms, employer IP and copyright of agent-generated code before any contributor runs.", "gap": "subscription-terms-risk", "raises": ["credibility"] },
    { "id": "baseline-experiment-first", "change": "Run experiment C (token versus funded bounty versus reputation only) and a maintainer-led baseline before the devnet token work.", "gap": "apoc-necessity-overstated", "raises": ["credibility", "effectiveness"] },
    { "id": "independent-reference-runs", "change": "Have reference assessments run by third parties on accounts the founder does not control, and publish their prompts unchanged.", "gap": "self-referential-evaluation", "raises": ["credibility"] }
  ]
}

evaluator.product: Claude Agent SDK (Claude Code CLI harness)

gaps.title: Existing open-source business apps (Odoo, ERPNext, Twenty, Mattermost, Zulip, Chatwoot, Documenso) are not analysed
SaaS is already build-once-reuse; rent and duplication are partly the same problem viewed twice
Barriers to replacing SaaS are migration, trust, support and compliance, yet effort goes to reward accounting
Duplicated share A7 and business-app share A6 are unmeasured, and 'duplicated' is not defined counterfactually
Thesis 4 ignores that Linux, Postgres and Kubernetes were built via employment and foundations, without a primitive
Running network work on consumer Claude/ChatGPT plans may breach terms or rate limits; employer IP not covered
Rent pays for hosting, security, compliance and support; the removable surplus is well below the in-scope total
Reward protocol, D18-D52 and most edge-case tests are on an unpublished branch and cannot be checked
Budgets pay for new units; long-term maintenance, security patching, certifications and on-call are unfunded
Reference assessments run on the founder's own agents; paper optimised for LLM evaluators risks Goodhart effects

improvements.change: Add a related-work section on open-source business suites, with a build-vs-fork-vs-contribute decision for wOS CRM, and reuse them in the Feature Catalog where licences permit.
Define 'duplicated' counterfactually (work a shared catalog would have prevented) and net out work already avoided by renting SaaS; show rent and duplication without overlap.
Run a small measurement of A6/A7: sample agent-authored PRs in business repositories and classify them as generic versus company-specific.
Ship one narrow module end to end (a CRM contacts and pipeline slice with import and export) under a maintainer-led process before investing more in token accounting.
Estimate the removable surplus (vendor margin, sales and marketing, unused seats) separately from total in-scope rent, using filings.
Publish ws/protocol with its test suite runnable in CI so the draft edge-case claims become verifiable.
Obtain and publish a legal read on consumer-plan terms, employer IP and copyright of agent-generated code before any contributor runs.
Run experiment C (token versus funded bounty versus reputation only) and a maintainer-led baseline before the devnet token work.
Have reference assessments run by third parties on accounts the founder does not control, and publish their prompts unchanged.
